stops.note: 'cap of death', the black cap a judge put on to pass a death sentence; one proposed source among several (Yiddish and the heraldic 'caboshed' are others), so the origin is unsettled
first recorded in Charles Dickens's Sketches by Boz (1836) as 'kye-bosk'

current_meaning: (put the kibosh on) to put a decisive end to something
